name: ABCCApp public addFixedDay reward time skip
summary: ABCCApp's addFixedDay(), a time offset added to block.timestamp when accruing daily rewards, had no access control. The attacker deposited 12,500 flash-borrowed USDT, called addFixedDay(1e9) so its whole 25,000 USDT reward cap (twice the deposit) was claimable at once, claimed it in DDDD from the contract's holdings and sold the DDDD for USDT.
notes: Loss: ABCCApp's net DDDD outflow (its 2,959,187.89 DDDD out less the DDDD the attacker's own deposit bought), minus the 303,086.72 DDDD claim fee paid to the protocol vault 0xa446dc21. DDDD has no DefiLlama price and the dump crashed it, so it is valued at what the attacker realised, 10,062.26 USDT net of the repaid flash loan (rule 12).

fixedDay is global, but no claimDDDD call follows the anchor before the owner withdrew the contract's DDDD with emergencyFixed (0xe3d80da8, block 58627430); the 47 earlier calls are ordinary deposits.
